title: [Android] Looking for testers for my turn-based roguelite - play as a slime, devour enemies and steal their abilities!
author: Right_Building_8032
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I’m currently developing a **turn-based mobile roguelite where you play as a slime**.

When you encounter an enemy, defeating it isn’t your only option. You can:

* **Devour it** to absorb abilities or passive effects, sometimes with unexpected drawbacks
* **Defeat it** to gain experience
* **Spare, talk to or knock it out**, which may affect future encounters and how other creatures react to you

https://preview.redd.it/b7e2dlz9trgh1.png?width=1200&format=png&auto=webp&s=6e146634e5123c5ac7924c6c8cd0b3d463235909

The idea is to let players gradually create their own unique slime build while making meaningful choices during each run.

The game is now approaching its first public release on Android, and I need **at least 12 testers for a 14-day Google Play closed test** before I can submit it for official release.

I’m looking for Android players who would be willing to:

* Install and keep the game enrolled during the testing period
* Play it at least a few times
* Report bugs or confusing elements
* Share honest feedback about the gameplay, balance and overall experience

Participation is completely free. The form asks for your email address because I need the **Google account connected to your Play Store** to grant you access to the closed test. Your address will only be used for the test and related updates, no spam.

👉 **Join the closed test here:**  
[**https://forms.gle/mhsBpY1Jxz5kshMr9**](https://forms.gle/mhsBpY1Jxz5kshMr9)

Every tester will directly help me improve the game and get it one step closer to an official launch.

Thanks a lot for your support! Questions, suggestions and first impressions are also very welcome in the comments. 🎮🟢
